{{Quote|It is my pleasure to introduce the fourth member of Klatooine's first Jedi delegation, Raharra, Clan Lapti.|Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>}}
The '''Jedi delegation''' consisted of four representatives on the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] stationed on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], as part of a number of agreed upon concessions demanded by the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] leadership to accompany their admission into the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. Negotiated and organized in [[44 ABY]] by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], the delegation consisted of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Kyp Durron]], Master [[Sothais Saar]], a [[Chev]] Knight well-known across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for his stance against the practice of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Bandy Geffer]], and the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] Padawan [[Raharra Lapti]].
